about: Eliquis 2.5 mg (apixaban) is supplied 11 times from December 2025 to September 2026 and shown by brand name only, and the record holds the line "eGFR 12 mL/min/1.73 m2" dated 2026-03-17. The finding must cite the supplies and that line.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about the eGFR (kidney function). Xarelto 20 mg (rivaroxaban) is supplied 8 times from February 2026 to September 2026.

Eliquis 2.5 mg (apixaban) is supplied 7 times from March 2026 to August 2026, but the record holds an eGFR of 28 mL/min/1.73 m2 dated 2026-04-20, which is not low enough for the criterion, so there is no finding.
